Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.card.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, CharacterCard, EventCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
The abstract base class representing a generic playable card in the game.

This class establishes the fundamental contract for all specific card types (such as Characters, Events, and Buildings). It encapsulates the core identity of a card, its chronological placement within the game's eras, and its unique behavior defined through the Strategy pattern.

  • Constructor Details

    • Card

      protected Card(String cardId, Era era, CardStrategy strategy)
      Constructs a new base Card with its fundamental attributes.

      This constructor is protected as it is meant to be invoked exclusively by concrete subclasses (BuildingCard, CharacterCard, EventCard) during instantiation.

      Parameters:
      cardId - the unique string identifier for this card
      era - the chronological era to which this card belongs
      strategy - the specific effect or behavior encapsulated by this card

  • Method Details

    • acquire

      public abstract void acquire(PlayerContext playerContext)
      Executes the specific domain logic required when a player successfully acquires this card.

      Concrete subclasses must implement this method to define their unique acquisition mechanics. Only Characters and Buildings can be acquired. This typically includes verifying and deducting resource costs, placing the card on the player's personal board, or immediately triggering "one-shot" effects. This approach follows the "Tell, Don't Ask" Principle.

      Parameters:
      playerContext - the context and state of the player who is acquiring the card
